name: verifier-boundary
title: The verifier is outside the loop: closing the observable boundary, and the split that makes room to say it
description: The question carried since round 6 has an answer the field already gave: a verdict is about task-level outcomes, and an instrument change is a verifier change - so it is not a loop turn, and it is judged by its suites and a person. Move two record-shaped contract groups into the specification that documents records, and write the boundary where the loop is specified
